:::{#def-validation-error}
#### Validation error

The **validation error** of a [fitted model](#def-fitted-model) $\fitted$
fitted to a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$
is its sample mean [loss](#def-observation-loss) $\obsloss{\iobs}$
on the [validation set](#def-validation-set), indexed by $\validx$:

$$
\valerr \eqdef \avgon{\validx} \obsloss{\iobs}.
$$ {#eq-validation-error}

:::
